Writing signals

## Common AI-Like Writing Patterns We Check

The detector reviews common patterns often found in generated or heavily AI-assisted writing.

### Repetitive Sentence Structure

Repeated sentence shapes can make a draft feel mechanical.

### Predictable Phrasing

Generic phrases and formulaic wording may raise AI-like signals.

### Generic Academic Tone

Overly polished academic wording can sound less personal and less specific.

### Low Writing Variation

Strong writing usually varies rhythm, length, and paragraph flow.

### Mechanical Transitions

Repeated transition words can make arguments feel template-based.

### Unnatural Paragraph Flow

AI-like paragraphs may move too smoothly without specific reasoning.
